manifest_role: Content-bound enumeration of every canon subject pending baseline review, with the disposition and written reasoning of one accountable reviewer. Presenting this manifest to --accept advances the baseline. It closes no work item, certifies no stage, and changes no status.
instructions: Fill reviewer_ref, and per subject a disposition (unaffected | successor_required | blocked) and a review_note that argues it from what actually changed.

`unaffected` must be ARGUED. Say why this subject's change does not reach the stages, modules, and work items named in review_required below. An unargued `unaffected` is a mechanical accept with extra steps.
Never rewrite a verified closure to absorb a semantic change: disposition it `successor_required` and open a successor record that states what must now be proven.
Do not edit the ids or digests. They bind this manifest to one exact revision, and --accept refuses if they drift.

subjects.review_note: The blocker ledger changed only because files that were untracked during the prior projection became tracked in the program commit and therefore entered the program fingerprint; no blocker state or closure premise changed.
The current-baselines projection now binds the complete post-commit tracked file set; the selected M0 baseline, historical literal, and every stage status remain unchanged.
The effect census changed only in its enclosing program fingerprint after the new program files became tracked; route identities, effects, and final-invoker classifications are byte-equivalent.
The M0 exit report projects the converged tracked-program fingerprint without changing its verified result, claim boundary, retained literal reference, or evidence status.
The manifest rebinds hashes for the same nine deterministic projections after the new files entered Git's tracked set; it advances no proof, status, or literal.
The PG gate map differs only by the converged program fingerprint; no PG assignment, threshold, gate state, or disposition changed.
The evidence index updates projection hashes for the post-commit tracked set while every retained evidence path and literal byte remains unchanged.
The release ladder rebinds the post-commit program fingerprint only; M0 remains verified, M4 remains active, and no advancement is asserted.
The selected profile's program fingerprint now includes the newly tracked records and freeze manifest, but its profile, claim, evidence reference, and status are unchanged.
